mapper.select: select * from payment where order_no = #{orderNo} and status in (0, 1) order by id desc limit 1

select p.* from payment p join `order` o on o.order_no = p.order_no join mock_pay_trade t on t.payment_no = p.payment_no where p.status = 1 and o.status = 0 and t.status = 2 and t.callback_status != 1 order by p.id asc limit 100
select * from payment where order_no = #{orderNo} and status in (0, 1, 4) order by id asc

select distinct p.order_no from payment p join mock_pay_trade t on t.payment_no = p.payment_no join `order` o on o.order_no = p.order_no where t.status = 2 and t.callback_status != 1 and p.status in (0, 1, 4) and o.status in (0, 2) order by p.order_no asc limit 100
